versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the "test-cases" skill for generating structured test cases from PRD documents or user requirements.
- Automatically produces detailed functional, edge case, error handling, and state transition test cases with complete requirement coverage.
- Outputs test documentation in standardized markdown format, including a coverage matrix.
- Guides users through clarifying requirements, creating requirement-traceable test cases, and saving to organized files.
- Provides a summary of coverage and assumptions in Chinese after generation.
